children: Equity LifeStyle Properties reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $409.9 million, up 4.2% from a year earlier, while net income available to common stockholders declined 11% to $86.4 million and diluted EPS fell to $0.45. Earnings included a $12.1 million deferred tax valuation allowance.
Revenue was $409.9M, compared with $393.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 4.2%.
Net income available to common stockholders was $86.4M, compared with $97.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (11.0%).
Diluted EPS was $0.45, compared with $0.50 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (10.0%).
Core property revenue increased 4.4% in the quarter, while property income excluding management costs grew 6.7%.
Core manufactured-home rent rose 5.7%, primarily from rate gains; occupancy was 93.8%, down from 94.4% a year earlier.
Core annual rent at RV and marina properties grew 5.3%, while seasonal and transient revenue declined 4.4% and 5.8%, respectively, mainly due to lower occupancy.
Rental-home revenue increased 12.9% as occupancy and rates improved. New-home sales fell 18.5% to 97 units.
The portfolio included 453 properties and approximately 173,600 sites. Management expects long-term demand to outpace limited new community supply.
